title: Resolve unit references
responsibility: Create links for registered or currently viewed units within the captured workspace scope.

inputs.name: unitLinks.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace with snapshot, selected entity, busy state and pinning state.

inputs.name: unitLinks.current
inputs.description: Optional current entity detail; defaults to null and is used only for the entity actually selected.

outputs.name: unitLinks
outputs.description: Resolver returning unit name, category and route, or null for invalid IDs, absent units, busy state or changed project/revision scope. Pinned views keep their commit in the route.
